'''Mustafarians''' were an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. They were divided into two [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]]: the taller, thinner northern Mustafarians, and a smaller, stockier, and hardier southern Mustafarians.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:SouthernMustafarian-SWG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A stockier southern Mustafarian]]
An [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Mustafar Lava Miner" /> the two [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of Mustafarians had different physiologies as well as different roles in their society. The [[Northern Mustafarian/Legends|northern Mustafarians]] were significantly taller than their [[Southern Mustafarian/Legends|southern cousins]] and physically weaker. Because of their frail physiology, those who served as sentries commonly had their limbs enhanced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic prosthetics]].<ref name="THEGtAS" />

The southern Mustafarians were stronger and shorter in stature than their northern cousins. They handled the "heavy lifting" jobs of the their planet's lava mining, and could withstand higher temperatures than northerners. Since they spent more time near the lava, they wore [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] and thick [[Mustafarian armor|armor]] to compensate.<ref name="THEGtAS" />

There were similarities between the two subspecies, though. Both were hard-shelled arthropods with long snouts and insectoid [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Their exoskeletons lay in plates over leathery skin, serving as protection from the heat they experienced on Mustafar. Unlike most species of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], they had very little [[Water/Legends|water]] in their bodies.<ref name="THEGtAS" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:SouthernMustafarian-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|250px|A Southern Mustafarian holding a lava skimmer.]]
They fashioned [[Armor/Legends|armor]] from [[Lava flea/Legends|lava fleas]] to protect themselves from the hotter lava flows on the surface which separated Mustafarian townships such as [[Fralideja/Legends|Fralideja]]. Even without lava flea armor, Mustafarian skin was tough enough to resist standard [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts, so they used [[Kinetic-blast rifle|weapons]] which fired bolts of kinetic force instead. They were not a naturally aggressive species, but used the weaponry as protection.<ref name="THEGtAS" />

Mustafarians spoke a buzzing, insectoid language<ref name="DB-Mustafarian" /> and had a highly symbolic culture. Their architecture was based on the shape of the [[Kahel cave fungus/Legends|kahel cave fungus]], and they lived and worked in saucer-shaped buildings near mine entrances. These buildings extended several levels below the ground, often utilizing empty mines that no longer produced ore.<ref name="THEGtAS" />

Southern Mustafarian miners rode harvesting platforms skimming over the active lava flows, extracting metals with large, pole-mounted cauldrons.<ref name="THEGtAS" />

==History==
[[File:LavaFlea-CVDNE.png|thumb|right|200px|A northern Mustafarian riding a lava flea]]
The Mustafarians evolved from extremophilic arthropods whose natural habitat was the slightly cooler hollows and caves inside Mustafar's dormant volcanoes.

When the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] arrived on Mustafar about three hundred years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Mustafarians signed a trade treaty with the off-worlders. Technology gained through trade allowed the Mustafarians to survive even the harshest conditions on their homeworld and improved their living conditions. In return, the Mustafarians helped build and manage operations on Mustafar to extract minerals for the Techno Union.<ref name="THEGtAS" />

Because of this, they obtained membership in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the movement used their planet as one of its main headquarters. During the Clone Wars, the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] enlisted the Mustafarians to build a climate-controlled fortress which was to be used as a protective retreat in the event that the Republic prevailed. After [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|massacre]] of the Separatist Council and Techno Union leaders in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Mustafarians were happy to have gained control of the fortress and were left to manage their own affairs.<ref name="THEGtAS" />

However, it is believed that the fortress was decimated by [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when the renegade [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] Separatist [[Gizor Dellso]] retreated there, refusing to surrender to the Empire.<ref name="THEGtAS" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], certain Mustafarians, though they kept to themselves, supported the Empire.<ref name="SW:FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

==Mustafarians in the galaxy==
Notable Mustafarians included Chief [[Armstrong]], Foreman [[Chivos]], [[Urup Fal'co]], and Chief [[Ulon Glost]]. At least [[Unidentified Mustafarian bounty hunter|one]] Mustafarian became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]; [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] employed this hunter in an attempt to kill [[Tyber Zann]], but the hunter failed and was killed by [[Urai Fen]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Mustaf.jpg|thumb|left|100px|A concept for a Mustafarian]]
[[File:Mustafar_Jedi.jpg|thumb|200px|Concept for a Mustafarian Jedi Knight]]
Some of the original designs for the Mustafarians were much more [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]. These designs were later used for the [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'ans]].

The Mustafarians look very similar to the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]], leading some to believe that they were one and the same species. Though this is not the case, ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'' depicts a Mustafarian wearing a [[Kubazian skirt]], which may point to a relationship between the species (similar to that of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] and [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]]).
